shortcuts.menu: Options for what’s under the pointer

sound.preampHint: Boosts are taken back first, so they never distort; turn this up to make up for it.
sound.monoHint: Both channels in each ear, for one earbud or a hard-to-hear side
sound.normalizeHint: Every song plays at about the same volume. Raygun learns how loud each one is as it plays.
sound.crossfadeHint: Each song fades into the next

songEdit.title: Edit {{title}}
songEdit.trimHint: Skip a long intro or a silent ending. The song starts and ends here wherever it plays.
songEdit.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
songEdit.volumeHint: Added to the volume levelling, for songs mastered too loud or too quiet.
songEdit.reset: Undo every change to this song
songEdit.moveLyrics: Move the lyrics with the start

lyricsEdit.offsetHint: Lines show this much later than their times. Play the song to sync it to a line as you hear it.
lyricsEdit.syncHint: Press “Now” beside a line as it’s sung, and the rest follow.
lyricsEdit.editHint: Change the words or times, add or remove lines. While the song plays, the stamp button gives the next line the time you press it.
lyricsEdit.playToStamp: Play this song to stamp each line’s time as it’s sung.
lyricsEdit.plainHint: Fix the words, or split them into lines to time them.
lyricsEdit.noneHint: No source has lyrics for this song. Type or paste them, then time them line by line.
lyricsEdit.placeholder: One line per line of the song
lyricsEdit.sourcesNone: None of your lyrics sources has this song.
lyricsEdit.hearQueued: Waiting to be heard · {{n}} in line
lyricsEdit.hearSetUp: Set up transcription in Settings → AI to hear the words.
lyricsEdit.transcribeQueued_other: {{count}} songs are being transcribed, one after another.

cueEdit.title: Lines
cueEdit.none: This track’s lines haven’t loaded yet.
cueEdit.embedded: Lines inside the video can only be shifted with the delay; pick a subtitle file to edit them.
cueEdit.heardHint: Press as you hear this line: every line moves to match
cueEdit.badTimes: Times look like 1:23.4, and the end comes after the start.

connect.title: Connect
connect.syncOff: Pair your phone and computer to keep favorites, playlists, history and settings the same on both, over your own network.
connect.playingThere: Playing there; this device controls it

status.notLinked: Not linked: link it in Devices

connect.noDevices: No linked devices yet. Link one in Devices.
connect.allowHere: Let your devices find this one
connect.allowHereHint: Your other Raygun devices can play on this one. The first time, this device asks you.

ask.title: Link a device
ask.question: Link with {{name}}?
ask.explain: {{name}} wants to link with this device. Linked devices keep your library, playlists, history and settings in sync, and each can play on the other. You can unlink it in Devices.

lyricsTranslate.title: Translate
lyricsTranslate.romanizedHint: The words in Latin letters, when a source has them
lyricsTranslate.downloadAsk: Download the translation model ({{size}})? It stays on this device for other songs.
lyricsTranslate.needsKey: Add its key in Settings → AI
lyricsTranslate.automaticHint: When a lyrics source has one in your language, or you made one before
lyricsTranslate.modelsHint: Download or remove them in Settings → AI

issue.title: Issue with source
issue.calm: It didn’t answer as expected. Everything else still works; try again later or use another source.

kind.dns: Couldn’t find {{source}}’s site — check your connection
kind.bot-check: {{source}} wants a browser check, which Raygun can’t do
kind.site-changed: {{source}} changed its site — its extension needs an update
kind.storage: Couldn’t read or write a file on this device
kind.permission: Raygun isn’t allowed to do that on this device

browserCheck.open: Open the site to pass the check
browserCheck.notPassed: The check wasn’t passed — no cookies came back

developer.title: Test sources
developer.hint: For testing Raygun with many sources, broken ones included: the suggested repository, Raygun’s sources that fail on purpose, and test video addons (legal films, live news). Not part of Raygun; remove them in Extensions and Addons.
developer.report: {{added}} added, {{already}} already there, {{failed}} couldn’t be added.

captions.title: Captions
captions.listening: Listening… captions appear as each part is done.
captions.onlineCost: This sends the audio to your transcription provider, which may charge for it. Raygun stays at most 10 minutes ahead of you.

barPopover.noUpdates: No new chapters or episodes. Library updates find them.

chapters.markPreviousRead: Mark the chapters before as read

otherSources.title: In other sources
otherSources.none: No other source has it under this name.
otherSources.noSources: Add more sources in Browse → Extensions to look in them.
otherSources.add: Add the copy from {{source}} to the library
otherSources.added: The copy from {{source}} is in the library
otherSources.useInsteadConfirm: Move this title to {{source}}? Progress carries over by chapter or episode number.

follow.alertsOn: Tell me about new releases from {{name}}
follow.alertsOff: Stop telling me about new releases from {{name}}
follow.noNews: Nothing new from the artists you follow yet.
follow.noNewsHint: Follow an artist and turn on the bell beside Follow.

lyricsCache.title: Lyrics
lyricsCache.usage: Lyrics kept for {{songs}} songs · {{transcriptions}} transcriptions · {{translations}} translated
lyricsCache.forget: Forget lyrics of songs not played for
lyricsCache.forgetHint: Their kept lyrics and transcriptions go; the switches below keep some always.

youtube.needsExtension: No installed source opens playlists and channels from this address.
youtube.ytdlpFetched: yt-dlp is fetched from its GitHub releases the first time you download
youtube.noFfmpeg: Videos save at up to 360p without FFmpeg.

updater.title: Updates
updater.installing: The installer is starting. Raygun closes while it updates and opens again after.
updater.needsPermission: Allow Raygun to install unknown apps in the settings page that opened, then tap Install the update.
updater.portableHint: This is the portable Raygun: download the new portable exe and put it in place of this one. Your data stays in raygun-data.

link.title: Your devices
link.description: Link your phones and computers once: they keep each other in sync, and you can play on any of them from the others.
link.sharing: Let your devices find this one
link.sharingOn: Your other devices can find this one, link with it, sync with it and play on it.
link.sharingOff: Turn this on to link devices. Linked devices sync as soon as something changes, and every few minutes.
link.shareFailed: Couldn't change whether devices find this one
link.noneNearby: No other Raygun on this network yet. Turn on the switch on your other device too.
link.turnOnToFind: Turn on the switch above to find your other devices.
link.unlinkDetail: They stop syncing and playing on each other.
link.qrAlt: QR code to link with this device
link.scanOnOther: Scan it with your other device: Devices → Scan a link code
link.codeUsed: This code was used. Make a new one to link another device.
link.noCamera: No camera here. Paste the code’s text instead.
link.cameraBlocked: Raygun can’t use the camera. Allow it, or paste the code’s text.
link.notACode: That isn’t a Raygun link code.
